aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.imgDescription: An photo of my self with two shaddows of the same picture, one in red and the other one in blue
aboutMe.paragraphOne: My name is Vinicius, and I am a Front-End Developer with over four years of hands-on experience building, maintaining, and supporting web applications using technologies such as React, Angular, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
aboutMe.paragraphTwo: I have contributed to projects focused on responsive design, performance optimization, and scalable UI architecture. I also have experience with automated testing, version control, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices, helping ensure code quality and reliable deployments.
aboutMe.paragraphThree: In addition to my development experience, I am a Technology Instructor with a background in teaching web development and other IT-related subjects, covering everything from fundamental concepts to industry best practices.
aboutMe.paragraphFour: I have experience delivering both in-person and online classes, as well as creating technology courses and educational content focused on software development and professional soft skills.
